method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied (the user of the service and the person complaining for them), with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING where it does not answer); the dates in one module (the only one importing daydate), the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; three regulative rules (ss 27(1) and 29 chained MUST on the Commissioner, s 66(4) MUST on the provider, s 94 SHANT) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Health and Community Services Complaints Act 1998 (NT), Act No. 29 of 1998, reprint REPH016 as in force at 13 August 2026 (the current reprint on the NT Legislation register on 6 November 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Health-and-Community-Services-Complaints-Act-1998-NT-current-reprint-REPH016.txt. Penalties in penalty units (value set by the Penalty Units Act, not computed).

seat: the user of a health service or community service and the person complaining for them (parent or guardian, attorney, person caring for the user's affairs, chosen representative): who may complain and about what, the time limit, the Commissioner's deadlines, when the complaint stops, conciliation, the investigation, the registration Board, and protection from pressure, reprisal and suit (hcscnt-complaints.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run hcscnt-dates.l4 ; l4 run hcscnt-complaints.l4 ; l4 run hcscnt-cases.l4
checks.result: 157 assertions written, 157 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); two deliberately wrong assertions in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Health complaints (the NT has no separate health records Act). In: s 4 (health service, community service, services for aged people and people with a disability, disability, user, special needs group); Part 5: ss 22, 23, 24(2), (8), 25 (through 30(6)), 27(1), 29, 30, 31, 33(2); Part 6: ss 36, 40, 42(1), (4), 43(1) to (3), 47(4), (5); Part 7: ss 54, 55(1), 59(1), 61, 65(2), 66(1), (2), (4), (5); Part 8: s 68(1), (3), (8); Part 10: ss 93, 94, 95(1), (2), 96, 97(1), 101. Out: ss 3, 5, 6, Parts 3 and 4, ss 24(1), (5) to (7), 25A, 26, 27(2) to (5), 28, 32, 34, Part 6 conciliator duties, Part 7 powers and privilege, Part 8 Commissioner-Board relations, ss 85 to 92, 95(3), (4), 97(2) to (6), 98 to 100, 102, 104 to 106, Part 11. Reasons in NOTES.md.
